backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing books, chapters, annotations, preferences, highlights, and blob storage with access control and various ordered maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files describing their responsibilities and behavior.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app routing setup with theme, language context, protected routes, and Internet Identity-based auth gating.
frontend/src/components/AnnotationsPanel: Annotations sidebar allowing users to create, edit, and delete chapter annotations with translated UI messages.
frontend/src/components/ChapterEditor.ts: Full-featured chapter editor with rich text, attachments, spell check, analysis, text improvements, exports, and auxiliary panels.
frontend/src/components/ChapterList.tsx: Component displaying a book’s chapters with creation, deletion, and selection logic using query hooks and navigation.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Simple centered empty-state message with an icon.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing localized text and a link, styled with theme components.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar with language selection, theme toggle, app title, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/SynonymSearchFie: Field for text or speech-based synonym search, fetching and parsing results from synonim.net with error handling.
frontend/src/components/TextToSpeechCont: Controls for browser-based Polish text‑to‑speech playback with voice selection, speed options, and saved preferences.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user profile name using mutation hooks with validation and toasts.
frontend/src/components/VoiceSearchField: Voice-based search input component using Web Speech API and backend lookup, handling permissions, errors, and result callbacks.
frontend/src/components/WriterLayout.tsx: Empty or placeholder layout component for writer-related pages.
frontend/src/components/WritingAnalysisP: Displays structured writing analysis results parsed from JSON or text, with loading state and close controls.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides language state, translation function, and persistence using user preferences and Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous backend actor instances, refetching dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and session state with AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend operations for books, chapters, profiles, and voice search.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive light/dark theme CSS variables plus styling for a clean Quill editor UI.
frontend/src/lib/exportError.ts: Provides utilities to extract safe, user‑friendly error messages while preserving replica rejection details.
frontend/src/lib/fileDownload.ts: Normalizes binary data to Uint8Array and handles file downloads and filename sanitization.
frontend/src/lib/quillAttachments.ts: Manages Quill image attachment references, parsing, placeholders, and resolved/unresolved states.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility for merging class names with clsx and Tailwind merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/BookPage.tsx: Displays a book overview with chapter list, handling loading states and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/BooksListPage.tsx: Manages listing, creating, editing, and deleting books with dialogs, backend checks, and user profile/setup logic.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Shows a chapter editor with chapter list and loading/empty handling.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login screen with Internet Identity authentication and language selection.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom color palette via CSS variables, extended container, shadows, radii, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a regression where the Add Book button stops working, along with related feature definitions, known issues, and pending requests.
